law: Free/OSS First. Tones live in the repo. No paid API. Mix-ready means headroom + slot vs drums/bass, not louder clipping.
chain: HP(LowCut+TIGHT) → Tight shelf → Body peak → Drive → tanh(MORPH) → Bite → Air → Gate → Delay/Reverb → Trim
oversample_note: 4x on the shaper unless the preset says otherwise. ADAA is native VST, not the browser shaper.
mix_law: Never win A/B by loudness. Trim after the chain. Guitar bus HPF is not the plugin LOW_CUT. Leave crest for drums. Stereo width after mono compatibility.

THALL.gate_behavior: fast chug mute, hysteresis 0.58, stay open only when GATE near 0
THALL.gain_structure: drive 0.72+GAIN^2*5.8 into tanh amount 1.4+GAIN^2*22, modern/asym morph 40
THALL.target: tight palm mute, pick attack at Bite, little room

mix.slot: dual rhythm, slightly inside the cymbals
mix.vs_bass: cut 80-110 Hz so 808/bass owns the floor
mix.vs_drums: gate aligned to kick; pick transient at Bite not snare 5 kHz

DJENT.gate_behavior: aggressive close on stops, short decay
DJENT.gain_structure: higher GAIN, morph toward symmetric tanh (odd harmonics)

mix.vs_drums: stops must be digital-silent or the grid dies
mix.trim: quieter than it feels in solo

DOOM.gate_behavior: mostly open, slow bloom, do not chop tails
DOOM.gain_structure: lower GAIN, morph toward asymmetric (even harmonics)
DOOM.target: thick low-mids, long notes, wetter delay

mix.slot: the mass under the vocal, not a snare competitor
mix.vs_bass: share 70-100 Hz; bass slightly rounder, guitar a bit of 90 Hz bark
mix.vs_drums: do not gate to kick; let cymbals ride over a wall
mix.trim: feel weight from BODY not from MASTER

BLACK_METAL.gate_behavior: medium, keep tremolo wash, no djent chop
BLACK_METAL.gain_structure: high GAIN, morph near modern, Air up
BLACK_METAL.target: ice on top, scooped body, hiss is the point

mix.slot: blizzard above the drums, not a chug pocket
mix.vs_drums: blast transients must cut through AIR; do not dull the hiss
mix.trim: if it sounds polite, AIR is too low

DEATH_METAL.gate_behavior: close on stops, keep riff sustain; faster than black, slower than djent
DEATH_METAL.gain_structure: high GAIN, slight modern bias, do not scoop all mids
DEATH_METAL.target: articulate chug + grind, kick still visible

mix.vs_drums: 2.5 kHz bite vs snare 4-6 kHz — do not stack
mix.trim: chainsaw in solo, smaller in mix

DEATH_HM2.gate_behavior: medium; buzz saw should ring between notes a little
DEATH_HM2.gain_structure: GAIN high, BODY is the HM-2 bump not low-end, BITE reinforces 1-1.5 kHz
DEATH_HM2.target: saw, not djent click, not black hiss

mix.vs_bass: keep 100 Hz out of the guitar or the bump becomes mud
mix.vs_drums: snare needs 200 Hz body elsewhere; guitar owns 800-1500
mix.mono: must survive — the bump is mono information
mix.trim: if kick disappears, BODY is too low in frequency

STONER.gate_behavior: almost open; only shave hiss between songs, never chop sustain
STONER.gain_structure: lower GAIN than death, MORPH almost asymmetric; optional algebraic cousin if calibrated
STONER.target: brown mid, sag, live tails, room not pad

mix.vs_bass: blend 60-90 Hz; fuzz guitar can own 100 Hz bark
mix.vs_drums: no grid-mute; snare through the fog
mix.mono: check; some collapse is the sound

CLEAN_AMBIENT.gain_structure: almost no clip, morph to asym for soft even harmonics, SPACE wet

mix.vs_bass: high-pass the pad if it fights sub

MODERN_METAL.gate_behavior: studio mute, not as snappy as DJENT
MODERN_METAL.target: works in a mix without extra EQ
